title: Gimbal radar returns as interference or echoes of a distant jet

tellings.quote: Perhaps there was a distant jet and the the radar got messed up and it made it appear as you someone actually told me that as a possibility.

plain: The radar readings tied to the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy recording of an unidentified object off the US East Coast, may have come from a distant jet, with the radar going wrong and making it look like something else. A UFO skeptic named Mick West says someone actually suggested this to him as a possibility, and he does not name the person. If true, it would mean the radar did not show anything strange after all.
